title: Ugly Bedside Organizer Needs 11" Clearance From Mattress to Floor
text:
Ugly Bedside Organizer Needs 11" Clearance From Mattress to Floor. This INTERDESIGN 04953 WREN BEDSIDE STORAGE ORGANIZER (for Phone, Tablet, Magazines, Water Bottle, Remote Control - 4 Pockets, Light Gray) is just plain ugly. It's made of heavy, coarse, taupe canvas that is stitched (and probably glued) to a stiff, rubberized ivory backing. The fabric feels unpleasant to the touch.

The organizer doesn't hold thick items, because the large and medium pockets are stitched down almost flat to the backing. Only the water bottle pocket has gussets to allow for insertion of a bulky item. The product photo showing the pockets curving outward is misleading. That mostly happens when items are inserted into the pockets, and then the organizer doesn't lie flat against the side of the bed.

The organizer installs easily by pushing the wire frame between the mattress and box springs, but it hangs almost to the floor on my bed. (It needs 11" vertical clearance from the bottom of the mattress to the floor.) As a result, the organizer is in the way of my feet when I get into bed, if I install it where it's easiest to reach when I'm in bed.

The between-the-mattress-and-box-springs installation means that the organizer (with its contents) must be removed whenever you change the sheets. The organizer also gets in the way of your bedcovers, unless you install it at the very head of the bed. The organizer can be easily removed from the wire frame for cleaning, because it is attached with a strip of heavy Velcro.

I was hoping to use this organizer to hold things that wouldn't fit on my crowded bedside table, but it's too inconvenient for regular use. InterDesign products are usually much nicer than this one.
